apps.versionDescription: Spotify Core v0.60.6 (Modified by Ares) — Built on Spotify 9.1.90: added 20 custom app icons under Appearance -> App icon (all iPhone & iPad sizes, iOS 16.1+ & iOS 26+, plus Liquid Glass icons on iOS 26+), active icon preview in settings header, Liquid Glass UI & Legacy UI, built-in Premium & ad-blocking, synced lyrics & Sing mode, offline downloads, Audio DSP, AutoMix, Live Activity, and Safari link opener.
apps.localizedDescription: Spotify Core (Modified by Ares) built on Spotify 9.1.90: 20 custom app icons in Appearance -> App icon (iOS 16.1+ & iOS 26+), Liquid Glass UI (iOS 26+) & Legacy UI (iOS 16.1+), built-in Spotify Premium & ad-blocking, synced lyrics & Sing mode, offline downloads, Audio DSP, AutoMix, Live Activity, and Open in Spotify Core Safari extension.
